verdict.rationale: Helicone documents prompt version tracking/comparison and rollback (docs-18) plus real-time automated scoring via webhooks (docs-23) and a playground for iterating on prompts (gh-3/gh-6), which are adjacent building blocks for regression detection, but there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'eval run' comparison view or side-by-side regression report across prompt/model versions. Missing for 10: a documented eval-run comparison UI, dataset-based batch evaluation runs, and any hands-on/community confirmation of side-by-side regression catching.
